prompts.series_annotator: Call build_fold_cot_context() FIRST to analyze the validation folds. Then return ONLY JSON with the SeriesProfile per the output schema in your instructions. No markdown, no explanation — only the JSON object.
prompts.strategy_selector: Call strategy_brief() FIRST — it contains the SeriesProfile and the full candidate library. Use series_profile fields to justify every selection. Return ONLY JSON per the output schema. No markdown, no explanation.

series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and moderate seasonality with high noise levels. Concept drift and unstable rankings suggest a weighted combination approach with dynamic error adjustment is appropriate to adapt to changing model performance.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift present; ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance (Gaillard & Goude 2015)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35 → high regularization with shrinkage (Hansen et al. 2011) and top_k=4 (Stock & Watson 2004)
reasoning.topk_mean_per_horizon_k4: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure (Timmermann 2006)
